# ResolvedFlowMap { #timetoalign.timelines.ResolvedFlowMap }

```python
timelines.ResolvedFlowMap(timeline, unit, number_type, chunks)
```

A played order as stretches of a root timeline's axis, placed in order.

What :meth:`FlowMap.resolve` returns, and, as a :class:`PlayedFlow`,
what :meth:`Timeline.get_flow <timetoalign.timelines.Timeline.get_flow>`
computes from flow control without writing anything. The virtual axis
starts at 0 with the first stretch and has the root's unit and number
type; every position in and out is a
:class:`~timetoalign.core.Coordinate` in that number type.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name        | Type                                                                                                                                                    | Description                                                                  |
|-------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| timeline    | [str](`str`)                                                                                                                                            | The ID of the timeline whose stretches are played.                           |
| unit        | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`)                                                                                                           | The unit of both axes.                                                       |
| number_type | [NumberType](`timetoalign.core.enums.NumberType`)                                                                                                       | The number type of both axes.                                                |
| chunks      | [tuple](`tuple`)\[[PlacedChunk](`timetoalign.timelines.flow.flowmap.PlacedChunk`) \| [PlacedGap](`timetoalign.timelines.flow.flowmap.PlacedGap`), ...\] | The stretches in the order played, each placed where the one before it ends. |

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [fold](#timetoalign.timelines.ResolvedFlowMap.fold) | Return the root position played at a position of the virtual axis. |
| [from_stretches](#timetoalign.timelines.ResolvedFlowMap.from_stretches) | Place stretches one after the other on a virtual axis. |
| [unfold](#timetoalign.timelines.ResolvedFlowMap.unfold) | Return every position of the virtual axis a root position is played at. |

### fold { #timetoalign.timelines.ResolvedFlowMap.fold }

```python
timelines.ResolvedFlowMap.fold(coordinate)
```

Return the root position played at a position of the virtual axis.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                                                                    | Description                                                               | Default    |
|------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| coordinate | [CoordinateInput](`timetoalign.timelines.flow.flowmap.CoordinateInput`) | A position on the virtual axis: a bare value or a Coordinate in its unit. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                | Description                                            |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`) \| None | The position on the root's axis, or None inside a gap. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
|--------|----------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the position lies outside the virtual axis, which is half-open (``[0, length)``), a Coordinate is in another unit, or an IdCoordinate names the root timeline, whose positions are not virtual positions. |

### from_stretches { #timetoalign.timelines.ResolvedFlowMap.from_stretches }

```python
timelines.ResolvedFlowMap.from_stretches(
    timeline,
    stretches,
    *,
    unit,
    number_type,
    **stated,
)
```

Place stretches one after the other on a virtual axis.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                                                                                                                         | Description                                                                                                                                                  | Default    |
|-------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| timeline    | [str](`str`)                                                                                                                 | The ID of the timeline the intervals lie on.                                                                                                                 | _required_ |
| stretches   | [Iterable](`collections.abc.Iterable`)\[[Interval](`timetoalign.core.Interval`) \| [Duration](`timetoalign.core.Duration`)\] | In the order played, an :class:`~timetoalign.core.Interval` of the timeline's axis for a stretch played and a :class:`~timetoalign.core.Duration` for a gap. | _required_ |
| unit        | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`)                                                                                | The timeline's unit.                                                                                                                                         | _required_ |
| number_type | [NumberType](`timetoalign.core.enums.NumberType`)                                                                            | The timeline's number type.                                                                                                                                  | _required_ |
| **stated    | [Any](`typing.Any`)                                                                                                          | What a subclass states beside the chunks (the ``findings`` of a :class:`PlayedFlow`).                                                                        | `{}`       |

### unfold { #timetoalign.timelines.ResolvedFlowMap.unfold }

```python
timelines.ResolvedFlowMap.unfold(coordinate)
```

Return every position of the virtual axis a root position is played at.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                                                                    | Description                                                                                                       | Default    |
|------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| coordinate | [CoordinateInput](`timetoalign.timelines.flow.flowmap.CoordinateInput`) | A position on the root's axis: a bare value, a Coordinate in the root's unit, or an IdCoordinate naming the root. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                          | Description                                                       |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [list](`list`)\[[Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`)\] | The virtual positions in the order played: one per stretch        |
|        | [list](`list`)\[[Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`)\] | covering the position (a stretch is half-open, its end excluded), |
|        | [list](`list`)\[[Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`)\] | none where it is never played.                                    |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                    |
|--------|----------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If a Coordinate is in another unit, or an IdCoordinate names another timeline. |
